high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by BBC News. The post features a photograph of a group of people gathered in what appears to be a stadium or sports venue. The individuals are standing on the stands, some holding up signs and cheering. The atmosphere suggests excitement and celebration. The text accompanying the image provides context about Newcastle United fans celebrating a significant event: the £305 million Saudi Arabian-backed takeover of the football club. The deal marks the end of businessman Mike Ashley's 14-year tenure at St James' Park.
